messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "mouth-related effects begin within minutes of a dose"
set: ["mouth-related effects begin within minutes of a dose", "most mouth-related effects resolve within an hour", "use the mixture within 15 minutes", "throw away if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "if child vomits within 30 minutes after taking, take another dose", "get new bottle if not taken within 60 minutes of mixing", "first dose administered 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "within a few hours to a day", "dose taken 30 minutes before start of single-day HEC", "first dose infused over 15 minutes", "first oral dose given 30 minutes before start of chemotherapy", "first parenteral dose infused over 15 minutes", "first dose given 30 minutes before the start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "first parenteral dose given 30 minutes before start of emetogenic chemotherapy", "begin dosing one week before quit day", "given as a bolus infusion over 15 minutes"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
